items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: I've seen Rudy Muck make them.

ctx.x: But I, naturally, I've been in and out of New York since 1939 and last time I was there, I had a coronet mouthpiece made, but as good as the mouthpieces this man makes, he doesn't have a...I don't know what you call it now, what would you call it? A mold. In other words, if he makes you a mouthpiece, he doesn't have a duplicate mold if you wanted another one.
Yeah. In other words, he... They usually put them on a lathe. I've seen Rudy Muck make them. That is the thing I'm talking about.

He doesn't have...he...when he makes you a mouthpiece, he doesn't take the lathe and...and have a duplicate. Yeah. So when you go there... You have to hold it and look at it. Right. When you go there, he's not going to make the mouthpiece exactly. No. See? Because if he had that mold, then he could just go by that mold.
